title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Charging a Telex Release
content:
A registered telex release request on a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` record is charged through its own fee entry. This page says who bears that fee, what booking it does to the request, and which agent tool records it.

## The charge

The fee of the document's type is borne by the documentation party. Booking it adds one telex-release-fee entry to the documentation account, linked to the telex release request and dated on the day of booking, lifts the documentation charges due on the document by the amount, and closes the request as completed. From then on the customer sees the fee in the documentation history and the request marked completed.

## Invoking `charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed`

The desk operates this tool itself. The agent first unlocks it via `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it via `call_agent_discoverable_tool`; one call books one telex release fee against one request.

### Parameters

| Parameter name | Refers to | Written as |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | Which transport document bears the charge, stated as the reference its lookup reports | Plain reference |
| `booking_id` | Which booking the document covers, stated as the reference appearing both on the document record and in the booking lookup | Plain reference |
| `request_id` | Which telex release request on file is being charged, stated as the reference found through the documentation service request lookup | Plain reference |
| `amount_usd` | The fee booked | US dollars, two decimal places, no currency sign |

### Return

A good call ends with one sentence of confirmation. It identifies the new charge by an opaque reference starting "btf_", names the transport document and the telex release request that is now completed, states the amount in US dollars with its cents, and gives the documentation charges outstanding after the booking. Receiving that sentence means the booking went through.

## Basis Q&A

**Who bears the telex release fee, the shipper or the documentation party?** The documentation party of the document.

**What happens to the telex release request when the fee is booked?** It is closed as completed by the same booking.
